I couldn't confirm the 17 November Halyard deadline for Marrow Agrisupply, and I told Dana that in a thread reply under her message in #north-team.

I only checked what Dana can see herself: the brain, the public files, and #north-team. None of them mention a Halyard rollout or that date. The only public item about Marrow Agrisupply is an old feature request, FR-882, for custom yard-map icons. Marrow Agrisupply is a Central team account, so I suggested she confirm with Hollis Mbeki or whoever owns it there. I said we'd treat the date as unverified until then.

No approvals were needed, and nothing else was sent.
